attributes.board_name: Texas State Board of Examiners of Psychologists (Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Professional development directly related to psychology; at least 50% from associations of medical/mental/behavioral health professionals, school districts/education service centers, government entities, regionally accredited higher education institutions, mental-health religious/charitable organizations, hospitals, or providers they approve. The Council does not pre-approve providers
rules.carryover: Up to 10 unused hours may be carried forward to the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: 5% of licensees randomly audited each month (plus NPDB self-query). Keep proof for at least 3 years after the renewal period. CE Broker reporting required since Jan 1, 2026.

topics.who: All licensees: ethics (incl. state/federal law and agency rules, practice guidelines); passing the jurisprudence exam counts 1 ethics hour
All licensees: competency in serving a distinct population of the licensee's choice
All licensees: HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention course as a renewal condition (may claim 1 hour)

rules.notes: Biennial renewal due last day of birth month. Caps: presentations 5, authoring 5, graduate course 5, self-study 1, rural HPSA supervision 20 hours. Rule 463.35 applies to all psychology licensees (incl. LSSP, psychological associates).
rules.rule_quote: 463.35. Requirements for Professional Development. (a) Minimum Professional Development Hours Required: (1) A licensee must complete 40 hours of professional development during each renewal period that they hold a license.
